question: The Government of India started DACE scheme in April 2022. This scheme was launched under which of the following ministries?

options.text: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

solution:
The correct answer is the __**Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On** April 22, 2022**, the** Dr Ambedkar Foundation** and the **Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment** announced the launch of the** Dr Ambedkar Centers of Excellence Scheme.**
 
• **The Dr Ambedkar Centre of Excellence (DACE)** was established as part of this** programme at the University of Allahabad.**
 
• The DACE program's goal is to give **Scheduled Caste (SC)** students **High-Quality Free Coaching Services **for the **Civil Services Examinations,** which are held by UPSC.
 
• The DACE is dedicated to giving** SC students** a top-notch education that will increase their** knowledge, foster critical thinking, improve their problem-solving abilities, and boost their self-assurance.**
 
• The coaching process lasts a **whole year.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
